title: Add support for warning messages t odumpcap.
description:
pcap_activate() can return warnings, which indicate that activating a
device succeeded but something the caller requested can't be done, such
as promiscuous-mode capture.

For capturing, this lets us display them in a GUI as, for example,
warning rather than error message boxes.

For other operations, we ignore them for now, as 1) they're not going to
occur in most if not all cases, as we're not making such requests and 2)
even if they do, they might contribute additional noise.

Clean up some comments while we're at it.

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass

+/* Write a warning message, with primary and secondary warning messages as

+    sync_pipe_write_string_msg(pipe_fd, SP_WARNING_MSG, warning_msg);
+    sync_pipe_write_string_msg(pipe_fd, SP_WARNING_MSG, secondary_warning_msg);
